title: Leuprorelin 11.25 mg: hormone injection every 12 weeks
indication_text: Prostatic carcinoma for which testosterone suppression is indicated.
purpose: Lower testosterone to help control prostate cancer. Your team explains whether the goal is cancer control or part of a plan that includes radiotherapy.
schedule_summary: Leuprorelin 11.25 mg is given under the skin or into a muscle every 12 weeks. Keep the exact written next appointment date.
administration_text: A trained healthcare professional prepares and gives this Prostap 3 DCS formulation under the skin or into a muscle. It is used immediately after mixing. Different products, strengths, routes and intervals are not automatically interchangeable.
monitoring_summary: Repeat blood count, kidney and liver tests, blood glucose and bone blood profile when clinically indicated. Review symptoms, prostate-specific antigen (PSA), testosterone and scans according to the individual plan.

agents.name: Leuprorelin 11.25 mg
agents.mechanism: Leuprorelin initially stimulates the pituitary gland. Continued stimulation then reduces its signal to the testes, so testosterone falls. This explains both the early flare risk and sustained hormone suppression between injections.
agents.explanation: Leuprorelin initially stimulates the pituitary gland. Continued stimulation then reduces its signal to the testes, so testosterone falls. This explains both the early flare risk and sustained hormone suppression between injections.
agents.watch: Ask whether you need temporary anti-androgen tablets to protect against the initial testosterone flare. Report worsening pain, difficulty passing urine or an injection-site abscess. A low PSA is not a reason to stop injections. Blistering or peeling skin, mouth or eye sores, or a severe headache with vision changes needs urgent medical assessment.
risks: Hot flushes, sweating, fatigue and changes in sleep or mood
Reduced sex drive, erection difficulties and reduced fertility
Loss of bone strength, fracture risk, muscle loss and changes in weight
Changes in glucose, cholesterol and cardiovascular risk
Heart-rhythm changes; review other medicines that affect the QT interval
Initial flare with worsening bone pain or urinary obstruction
Injection-site pain, swelling or abscess; poor absorption can reduce hormone suppression
Depression, allergic reactions and rare raised pressure around the brain
Rare severe skin reactions: blistering, peeling or sores in the mouth or eyes need urgent medical help.

anatomy: Report severe low mood, marked fatigue or sleep problems. Ask for support early. Seek urgent help for a severe headache with vision changes, vomiting, confusion or collapse.
Hormone suppression can cause hot flushes. Ask about practical measures and treatments if troublesome.
Keep planned checks. Chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness needs urgent assessment.
Blood glucose, weight and cardiovascular risk need review; suitable activity and diet can help.
Report worsening swelling, pain or an abscess. Blistering, peeling skin or mouth/eye sores need urgent help.
Reduced desire and erection difficulties are common. Discuss fertility and contraception; ADT is not reliable contraception.
Ask about bone assessment, resistance exercise, falls prevention, calcium intake and vitamin D needs.
Report difficulty passing urine or worsening pain. New leg weakness or loss of bladder/bowel control is an emergency.

evidence.title: What the evidence can tell you
evidence.intro: Trial results describe groups of people; they cannot predict an individual outcome.
evidence.population: Prostatic carcinoma for which testosterone suppression is indicated.
evidence.comparison: Disease setting determines the relevant treatment comparison
evidence.interpretation: Hormone suppression and PSA response are different from survival. Choice of depot is based on formulation, interval, clinical circumstances and preferences; separate studies do not establish a survival ranking.
limitations: Response and progression endpoints are not the same as overall survival.
Trials do not predict the benefit or side effects for one individual.

consent_support: Discuss treatment aim, benefit and uncertainty, alternatives, the risks listed for each medicine, sexual health/fertility, monitoring and urgent contacts. Confirm exact formulation, route, interval and flare plan.
